add.evidence: The state defaults inspired the enactment of the Bankruptcy Act of 1841, although the Act did not apply to the states themselves
The state defaults inspired the enactment of the Bankruptcy Act of 1841, although the Act did not apply to the states themselves, and was soon repealed in 1843.
